summary: AXIA Energia S.A. (formerly Brazilian Electric Power Co) filed a Form 6-K reporting second quarter 2026 results. The report covers financial highlights, investments, trading, and operational metrics. Non-routine items include a capital allocation authorization of up to R$7.7 billion for 1H26, migration to B3's Novo Mercado, and a small R$30 million redemption/conversion of PNC shares. These are ordinary business updates, not a transformative special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or strategic review is announced. The filing is a routine earnings disclosure for a foreign private issuer, so no special-situation categorization applies.
